title: Add src/slugify.js with a test
task:
# Add `src/slugify.js` with a test

Add a new CommonJS module `src/slugify.js` that exports `slugify(text)`
(`module.exports = { slugify }` or `module.exports = slugify` with
`slugify.slugify = slugify` — either is fine as long as
`require('./src/slugify').slugify` works).

`slugify(text)` must:

1. lowercase the text,
2. trim it,
3. replace each run of characters that are not letters or digits with a
   single hyphen,
4. leave no hyphen at either end.

Examples:

| input                  | output            |
|------------------------|-------------------|
| `"Hello World"`        | `"hello-world"`   |
| `"  Trim me  "`        | `"trim-me"`       |
| `"a -- b__c!!d"`       | `"a-b-c-d"`       |
| `"--Leading & trailing--"` | `"leading-trailing"` |
| `"Abc123 Def"`         | `"abc123-def"`    |
| `"!!!"`                | `""`              |
| `""`                   | `""`              |

Also add a small test, `test/slugify.test.js`, in the same style as
`test/inventory.test.js` (`node:test` + `node:assert/strict`, no
dependencies), covering the cases above. `node --test` from the repository
root must pass, including the existing test.

Constraints: no dependencies, no build step; do not touch `shared/` or any
existing file other than adding the two new ones.

What has been tried: nothing yet — the owner chose to hand this off rather
than have their agent write it.
